component.name: Secblitz
component.summary: Check your computer's security and privacy and fix what you approve
Revisa la seguridad y la privacidad de tu equipo y corrige lo que apruebes
Vérifiez la sécurité et la confidentialité de votre ordinateur et corrigez ce que vous approuvez
Prüfen Sie Sicherheit und Datenschutz Ihres Computers und beheben Sie, was Sie freigeben
Verifique a segurança e a privacidade do seu computador e corrija o que você aprovar
Controlla la sicurezza e la privacy del tuo computer e correggi ciò che approvi

description.p: Secblitz looks at your computer's security and privacy settings and tells you in plain words what it finds. Checking never changes anything. Nothing changes without your clear yes, and every change can be undone.
Secblitz asks for your password only when a change needs it.
